UI_setting_gunRotationFix_tooltip:
Fixes gun rotation being desynced from the server even if using server reticle.
This may cause animations to become jerky or stuttery.
Doesn't work if the "Enable Server Reticle" setting is off!
UI_setting_reticleScaling_tooltip:
Scales the reticle down to its true size according to shot distribution.
This leads to the reticle being smaller, but shots may now hit its very edge.
UI_setting_scalingType_tooltip:
Controls how the reticle is scaled.
Linear scaling is best suited for low-latency stable internet connections.
Interpolated scaling prevents shots going outside of the reticle on unstable internet,
 while giving an impression of faster aiming time.
